analyst.summary: Cohance Lifesciences is a well-regarded pharma CDMO (contract manufacturer) benefiting from global supply-chain diversification away from China, but its most recent quarters show revenue and profit both declining sharply from a year-ago peak, working-capital days stretching out, and debt rising. We also note that promoters have pledged the large majority of their holding, per public shareholding data. We rate the stock a Hold, but flag these as genuine, current-quarter concerns rather than background noise -- this is a name to watch closely rather than treat as a steady compounder right now.
